title: Cognitive evaluation of brain organoids and assembloids
title_zh: 脑类器官和组装体的认知评估
abstract: The computational abilities of brain organoids and assembloids remain largely unexplored. We propose a hierarchy of assays grounded in cognitive neuroscience and probing representations, memory, and predictive processing, thus enabling causal tests of how architecture and maturation shape emerging computations while providing empirical constraints on debates about organoid consciousness.
abstract_zh: 脑类器官和组装体的计算能力尚未得到充分探索。我们提出了一套基于认知神经科学的测试方案体系，探测表征、记忆和预测加工，从而能够架构与成熟如何塑造涌现计算进行因果性检验，并为关于类器官意识的争论提供经验约束。
